Configure current feature

  1. Use world/biome-authoring.html to expand beyond the two-zone courtyard proof; author one biome at a time with explicit metrics and placeholder inventory.
  2. Add map/minimap discovery IDs, marker types and UI focus; place BP_DiscoveryVolume at named landmarks. Configure server clock/weather definitions with gameplay modifiers disabled initially.

Only place actors whose systems are active in this phase; later rows are staged expansion instructions, not a requirement to build all map content now. Keep placeholders labeled and preserve earlier test sections.

Run now: current-phase integrated scenarios

  1. Discover a Rillmere landmark, reconnect and cross zones; the same durable region marker remains unlocked. Compare public vs hidden quest markers for A/B.
  2. Advance server time/weather in a development control; both clients observe bounded clock convergence and accessible cues.
  3. Produce one new biome from the catalog: return gates, road NavMesh, valid ore/tree candidates, fish volumes, NPC services, encounters, ambience and QA records.
Expected success
No routine biome registration needs a new C++ owner; metrics are measured against proposed density/travel-time targets.
Map/clock/weather remain server-sourced where shared; client options may reduce cosmetic effects without changing outcomes.

Explicitly not active yet

  1. Six biome briefs are production designs, not completed3Dmaps. Ambient schedules enter only after functional zone lifecycle proof.

current-phase fixtureChanging local clock cannot reroll fish or resources.

Regression, disconnect and restart

  1. Restart the test environment twice; one admitted pawn per account, one local input context installation, no stale widgets.
  2. Repeat the previous phase success case after all new assignments; definitions missing from this phase must fail closed, not fall back to client saves.
  3. From phase03 onward run two separate clients; disconnect A while B remains, then reconnect with the correct identity.
  4. From phase05 onward query committed receipt/revision after timeout/restart. From06 onward reject old source epoch after transfer.

Stop condition and deferred work

New zones register without native rule changes; weather/discovery survive transfer policies.

Stop on a failed required assertion, missing required rule definition, duplicate authority or unverified dependency that this phase relies on. Legal debug art may support physics tests but cannot close the archive/PaperZD art gate. Do not activate future-phase systems merely because their full-game chapter exists.
